player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round Rock-Paper-Scissors game.
Your goal is to win as many rounds as possible.
In each round, respond with one of: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
You may also use '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' as shorthand.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say move di nakilala. Gawaten ya [rock], [paper], o [scissors].

game_action.selects: Pinili na manlalako {player_id} so move ya {move}.

message.round_win: Resulta na round: Manalo so {winner} ya manlalaban!

outcome.p0_wins: Say Player 0 so analo ed dakel a round!
outcome.p1_wins: Say unonan manalo so nanggawa na sankarakelan a round!
